Title: CyrenaBuilderExtensions - Application Builder Extensions
Summary: Extension methods on CyrenaBuilder for registering feature options, assemblies, startup tasks, assistant modes, and plugins.
Content:
## CyrenaBuilderExtensions

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Extensions`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Core`

### Purpose
Extension methods on `CyrenaBuilder` for registering feature options, assemblies, startup tasks, assistant modes, and plugins.

### Methods

#### AddFeatureOption<T>(CyrenaBuilder builder, T option)
Adds a named feature option to the builder. Key is the type name.

```csharp
public static void AddFeatureOption<T>(this CyrenaBuilder builder, T option) where T : class
```

#### GetFeatureOption(CyrenaBuilder builder, string name)
Retrieves a feature option by name.

```csharp
public static object? GetFeatureOption(this CyrenaBuilder builder, string name)
```

#### GetFeatureOption<T>(CyrenaBuilder builder)
Retrieves a feature option by type name.

```csharp
public static T GetFeatureOption<T>(this CyrenaBuilder builder) where T : class
```

#### AddFeatureAssembly(CyrenaBuilder builder, string key, Assembly assembly)
Adds an assembly to a feature group.

```csharp
public static void AddFeatureAssembly(this CyrenaBuilder builder, string key, Assembly assembly)
```

#### AddFeatureAssembly<T>(CyrenaBuilder builder, string key)
Adds the assembly containing type T to a feature group.

```csharp
public static void AddFeatureAssembly<T>(this CyrenaBuilder builder, string key)
```

#### GetFeatureAssemblies(CyrenaOptions options, string key)
Retrieves assemblies for a feature key from built options.

```csharp
public static IList<Assembly> GetFeatureAssemblies(this CyrenaOptions options, string key)
```

#### AddStartupTask<TStartupTask>(CyrenaBuilder builder)
Registers a startup task in the DI container.

```csharp
public static void AddStartupTask<TStartupTask>(this CyrenaBuilder builder) 
    where TStartupTask : class, IStartupTask
```

#### AddAssistantMode<TAssistantMode>(CyrenaBuilder builder)
Registers an assistant mode in the DI container.

```csharp
public static void AddAssistantMode<TAssistantMode>(this CyrenaBuilder builder) 
    where TAssistantMode : class, IAssistantMode
```

#### AddAssistantPlugin<TAssistantPlugin>(CyrenaBuilder builder)
Registers an assistant plugin in the DI container.

```csharp
public static void AddAssistantPlugin<TAssistantPlugin>(this CyrenaBuilder builder) 
    where TAssistantPlugin : class, IAssistantPlugin
```

### Usage
```csharp
builder.AddFeatureOption(new MyOptions());
builder.AddFeatureAssembly<MyAssemblyType>("my-feature");
builder.AddStartupTask<MyStartupTask>();
builder.AddAssistantMode<DefaultAssistantMode>();
builder.AddAssistantPlugin<MyPlugin>();
```

### Related
- `CyrenaBuilder` - The builder being extended
- `IStartupTask` - Startup task contract
- `IAssistantMode` - Mode contract
- `IAssistantPlugin` - Plugin contract
